insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Organic revenue grew +5.6% WoW to $11,886, the strongest signal of the week. The Posting Heel Wedge jumped to $1,078 (+35.0%) with a 52.2% conversion rate, the Metatarsal Pad 1-Pair rose to $948 (+9.1%) as CVR improved +33.0% to 32.9%, and the Large 6-Pair Pack grew to $2,211 (+8.2%). Wednesday, Nov 11 was the peak day at $3,177.

**Metrics to Watch —** The -4.2% dip in total sales (from $18,436 to $17,658) was primarily driven by lower ad spend of $2,462 (prior $3,251), which brought PPC revenue to $5,772 (-19.6%), while organic revenue grew to $11,886 (+5.6%). The Medium 6-Pair Pack eased to $4,435 (-12.8%) on sessions down -11.7%, and the Small 6-Pair Pack slipped to $875 (-47.7%) as its CVR fell to 11.4%. We are prioritizing both 6-Pair Packs to bring their volume back.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS improved to 2.34x from 2.21x and TACoS dropped to 13.9% from 17.64%, so each ad dollar is working harder. ACOS sits at 42.7%, with a 0.84% ad CTR and a strong 21.16% ad conversion rate, showing the leaner spend is reaching high-intent shoppers.

**Actions This Week —** Raise bids on the Medium 6-Pair Pack's best-converting search terms to recover sessions and sales. Review search terms and ad creative for the Small 6-Pair Pack to lift its 11.4% conversion rate. Expand targeting for the Posting Heel Wedge to build on its 52.2% conversion, while trimming low-converting terms to bring ACOS below 42.7% heading into the holiday season.
